english.note: Use this when the unreasonable thing is an excessive demand, amount, or action.

exampleSentences.english: Charging me so much for the moving service is unreasonable.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你收我咁貴嘅搬屋費，真係過分。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 sau1 ngo5 gam3 gwai3 ge3 bun1 uk1 fai3 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6

english.note: Use this when the main idea is that someone’s behavior, words, or demands have gone too far, especially offensively.

exampleSentences.english: It’s outrageous to berate him like that in front of so many people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你當住咁多人面前咁樣鬧佢，真係過分。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 gam3 joeng2 naau6 keoi5 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6
